task: Compare available plans for the AeroAPI on Flightaware.
agent_final_answer:
FlightAware offers three primary pricing tiers for AeroAPI: **Personal**, **Standard**, and **Premium**. Below is a detailed comparison of the plans based on FlightAware's official pricing structure:

---

### 1. Overview & Intended Use
* **Personal Tier**: Intended solely for personal, hobbyist, or academic projects. Storage and distribution of derivative works are strictly limited to non-commercial/academic use. Commercial use (B2B or B2C) is prohibited.
* **Standard Tier**: Intended for businesses, commercial operations, and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) applications. Permits internal business use and commercialization for B2C products.
* **Premium Tier**: Intended for enterprise and high-volume commercial deployments. Permits internal business use, B2C commercialization, and full Business-to-Business (B2B) commercial distribution.

---

### 2. Pricing, Minimums & Allowances
* **Personal**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **None ($0/month)**.
  * Free Credit: Up to **$5/month free** of query usage (or **$10/month free** for users hosting an ADS-B feeder).
  * Per-query usage billing applied for usage beyond the free credit.
* **Standard**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **$100/month**.
  * Billed on per-query usage fees, subject to the $100 monthly minimum.
* **Premium**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **$1,000/month**.
  * Billed on per-query usage fees, subject to the $1,000 monthly minimum.

---

### 3. Rate Limits
* **Personal**:
  * 10 result sets per minute.
  * Historical queries: Not available.
* **Standard**:
  * 5 result sets per second (~300 per minute).
  * Historical queries: Capped at 500,000 result sets per month.
* **Premium**:
  * 100 result sets per second (~6,000 per minute).
  * Historical queries: Capped at 500,000 result sets per month.

*(Note: In AeroAPI, one result set equals up to 15 records).*

---

### 4. Included Features & Data Sets
* **Current Flight Status & Position Tracks**: Included in Personal, Standard, and Premium.
* **Static Maps & Imagery**: Included in Personal, Standard, and Premium.
* **Flight Alerts (Departure, Arrival, Holding, etc.)**: 
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Included.
  * Premium: Included.
* **Historical Flight Data (Back to Jan 1, 2011)**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Included.
  * Premium: Included.
* **FlightAware Foresight™ (Predictive ETAs & ML technology)**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Not included.
  * Premium: Included (requires contacting FlightAware to enable; usage restrictions apply).
* **Aireon Space-Based ADS-B Data**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Not included.
  * Premium: Included (requires contacting FlightAware to enable; usage restrictions apply).

---

### 5. Support, SLA & Billing Options
* **Uptime SLA**:
  * Personal: None.
  * Standard: None.
  * Premium: **99.5% uptime guarantee**.
* **Customer Support**:
  * Personal: Community discussion forums only.
  * Standard: Email support.
  * Premium: Enterprise-grade support with both **email and phone support**.
* **Billing / Invoicing**:
  * Personal: Credit card only.
  * Standard: Credit card only.
  * Premium: **Invoicing available** (in addition to credit card).

---

### 6. Volume Discounting
* **Personal**: Not eligible for volume discounting.
* **Standard & Premium**: Both tiers qualify for progressive monthly volume discounts on usage exceeding $1,000/month:
  * $0 – $1,000/mo: List price (no discount)
  * $1,000 – $2,000/mo: 30% discount
  * $2,000 – $4,000/mo: 51% discount
  * $4,000 – $8,000/mo: 65% discount
  * $8,000 – $16,000/mo: 76% discount
  * $16,000 – $32,000/mo: 83% discount
  * $32,000 – $64,000/mo: 88% discount
  * Above $64,000/mo: 94% discount
  * Additional discounts are available for 3- or 4-year term commitments.

Example Code - AeroApps

FlightAware's AeroApps are here to show you what can be done with AeroAPI! Our AeroApps are open source sample applications available in different programming languages that help you learn how to use AeroAPI. The applications are available as Docker containers to make it easy to try them out. Just download the repo, set your AeroAPI key, and run docker-compose --profile <language> up where <language> is either python or java. This builds the backend service in the language of your choice and then launches both the backend and frontend services. The containers are also published to GitHub Packages, so you can get started even faster by running docker-compose pull first.

What is AeroAPI v4?

FlightAware released AeroAPI Version 4 (v4) as the next generation of our AeroAPI product in October 2021. AeroAPI v4 replaced legacy AeroAPI version 2 and 3 (v2/v3) offerings (previously known as FlightXML). Both v2 and v3 were sunset October 2023.




How far back is data available?

Using the GET /history/* resources will provide you with on-demand access to flight status and flight tracking data from January 1, 2011 onward.
Historical data can be requested for any given flight ident or registration number, as well as all flights arriving or departing from an airport. All historical access options can be found here in the documentation.

For all other endpoints, generally 48-72 hours of data is returned by default, with the additional flexibility to obtain up to 10 days of flight history using the start and end query parameters (see the documentation of each function for specifics). Further history can be purchased on a per-identification basis on the flightaware.com website. For other data needs, contact FlightAware commercial services.

---

### 1. Overview & Intended Use
* **Personal Tier**: Intended solely for personal, hobbyist, or academic projects. Storage and distribution of derivative works are strictly limited to non-commercial/academic use. Commercial use (B2B or B2C) is prohibited.
* **Standard Tier**: Intended for businesses, commercial operations, and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) applications. Permits internal business use and commercialization for B2C products.
* **Premium Tier**: Intended for enterprise and high-volume commercial deployments. Permits internal business use, B2C commercialization, and full Business-to-Business (B2B) commercial distribution.

---

### 2. Pricing, Minimums & Allowances
* **Personal**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **None ($0/month)**.
  * Free Credit: Up to **$5/month free** of query usage (or **$10/month free** for users hosting an ADS-B feeder).
  * Per-query usage billing applied for usage beyond the free credit.
* **Standard**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **$100/month**.
  * Billed on per-query usage fees, subject to the $100 monthly minimum.
* **Premium**:
  * Monthly Minimum Fee: **$1,000/month**.
  * Billed on per-query usage fees, subject to the $1,000 monthly minimum.

---

### 3. Rate Limits
* **Personal**:
  * 10 result sets per minute.
  * Historical queries: Not available.
* **Standard**:
  * 5 result sets per second (~300 per minute).
  * Historical queries: Capped at 500,000 result sets per month.
* **Premium**:
  * 100 result sets per second (~6,000 per minute).
  * Historical queries: Capped at 500,000 result sets per month.

*(Note: In AeroAPI, one result set equals up to 15 records).*

---

### 4. Included Features & Data Sets
* **Current Flight Status & Position Tracks**: Included in Personal, Standard, and Premium.
* **Static Maps & Imagery**: Included in Personal, Standard, and Premium.
* **Flight Alerts (Departure, Arrival, Holding, etc.)**: 
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Included.
  * Premium: Included.
* **Historical Flight Data (Back to Jan 1, 2011)**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Included.
  * Premium: Included.
* **FlightAware Foresight™ (Predictive ETAs & ML technology)**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Not included.
  * Premium: Included (requires contacting FlightAware to enable; usage restrictions apply).
* **Aireon Space-Based ADS-B Data**:
  * Personal: Not included.
  * Standard: Not included.
  * Premium: Included (requires contacting FlightAware to enable; usage restrictions apply).

---

### 5. Support, SLA & Billing Options
* **Uptime SLA**:
  * Personal: None.
  * Standard: None.
  * Premium: **99.5% uptime guarantee**.
* **Customer Support**:
  * Personal: Community discussion forums only.
  * Standard: Email support.
  * Premium: Enterprise-grade support with both **email and phone support**.
* **Billing / Invoicing**:
  * Personal: Credit card only.
  * Standard: Credit card only.
  * Premium: **Invoicing available** (in addition to credit card).

---

### 6. Volume Discounting
* **Personal**: Not eligible for volume discounting.
* **Standard & Premium**: Both tiers qualify for progressive monthly volume discounts on usage exceeding $1,000/month:
  * $0 – $1,000/mo: List price (no discount)
  * $1,000 – $2,000/mo: 30% discount
  * $2,000 – $4,000/mo: 51% discount
  * $4,000 – $8,000/mo: 65% discount
  * $8,000 – $16,000/mo: 76% discount
  * $16,000 – $32,000/mo: 83% discount
  * $32,000 – $64,000/mo: 88% discount
  * Above $64,000/mo: 94% discount
  * Additional discounts are available for 3- or 4-year term commitments.
